workout_logger_quality_bar: Progressive overload is explicit intent, not hidden magic.
Previous performance includes exact set, date, and readiness context.
Rest timing shows selected rest versus prescribed rest and a post-set countdown target.
Low readiness becomes active behavior: cap load/RPE, reduce planned sets, and block PR chasing before progression.
Pain safety blocks load progression, caps effort, and routes the user to pain-free work or finishing.
Technique substitutions load a conservative variation, visible cue, reduced effort, and plan-counting identity without overwriting the original exercise reference.
